{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Deep burgundy silk crepe sheath dress, midi length, #6D1B49, fluid woven fabric with a subtle drape
Navy wool-blend tailored blazer, single-breasted cut with notch lapels, #2F3050, structured yet soft hand
Black leather ankle boots, slim heel cut around 7cm, #1C1C1C, smooth finish with a pointed toe
Gold vermeil thin chain necklace, delicate link design, #FFD700, polished metal accent
Small structured evening clutch, rigid shape with top handle, #0A0A0A, matte leather texture

This outfit works because the rich burgundy dress elevates the date occasion into a smart, sophisticated look perfect for an evening restaurant setting. The navy wool blazer adds a layer of refinement and polish that aligns with the requested dress code while remaining comfortable enough for autumn weather without being too heavy. Completing the ensemble with sleek black ankle boots and delicate gold jewelry balances elegance with understated style, ensuring she feels confident and chic under artificial lighting."}
